title: Engineering Systems Atlas
purpose: A reference manual for how software is designed across this body of work — recurring systems, decision evolution, validation, and failure knowledge. It is not a project listing.

systems.title: AI System Design
systems.summary: AI is reached through explicit boundaries: deterministic cores stay predictable; assistants and agents use structured outputs or defined APIs rather than collapsing into domain persistence.

systems.title: API Boundary Design
systems.summary: Core calculation and inference sit behind package or HTTP boundaries that presentation layers call into — hos_engine without Django/network deps; FastAPI inference separate from React; AI behind backend APIs.

systems.title: Validation Strategy
systems.summary: Quality claims require measurement: mutation testing against clinical boundaries; committed notebook PSNR/SSIM over aspirational README bands; pytest scenarios for HOS rules.

systems.title: Testing Philosophy
systems.summary: Coverage alone is insufficient for safety-critical logic; specification-driven and adversarial tests kill boundary faults. Domain engines carry named scenario suites before UI polish.

systems.title: Deployment Philosophy
systems.summary: Deploy packaging is iterated until the domain engine is importable on the host; when GPU packaging is unreliable, inference defaults to CPU for a stable serving path.

systems.title: Failure Analysis
systems.summary: Failures are recorded with project attachment: clinical boundary mis-triage under mutation; undecodable images and PSNR variance; missing checkpoints; deploy import failures for hos_engine.

systems.title: Engineering Decision Records
systems.summary: Flagship case files record ADR-style decisions with Identity and repository provenance — deterministic/AI separation, domain-first HOS modeling, retrieval-first pipelines, research-as-product constraints.

systems.title: Documentation Standards
systems.summary: Public proof prefers committed reports, notebooks, and engineering case files over marketing copy; Missing and Deferred stay visible; README claims stay attributed.

decisions.decision: Separate deterministic backend paths from AI reasoning
decisions.evidence: Identity §18.3.1 Hardest decisions; Identity §18.3.4 Architecture (AI via well-defined APIs).
decisions.outcome: Operational auth/records/workflows stay predictable; assistants remain replaceable behind boundaries.

decisions.decision: Retrieve before generate for codebase questions
decisions.evidence: Identity §18.3.5 Architecture stages; repository README Architecture.
decisions.outcome: Answers expected to stay grounded in indexed source context rather than parameter memory alone.

decisions.decision: Implement FMCSA HOS as a pure-Python package with no web/DB dependencies
decisions.outcome: API/UI call plan_trip after routing; engine remains testable with pytest independently.

decisions.decision: Force CPU inference for the public enhancement API
decisions.evidence: api_server.py clears CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and sets torch device cpu.
decisions.outcome: Stable serving path when GPU packaging is unreliable; inference speed traded for deploy reliability.

decisions.decision: Treat mutation score as the quality signal for clinical logic, not line coverage alone
decisions.evidence: DEEPMED-Testing FYP report Tables 3/5/6 and reflections §3.4 / §4.4.
decisions.outcome: Baseline 97.88% line coverage with 70.15% mutation score; boundary tests raised score to 76.12%.

failures.title: Severity tier boundary misclassification
failures.detail: Mutants changing >= to > at scores 75 and 50 downgrade VERY_HIGH→HIGH or HIGH→MEDIUM when interior tests miss exact boundaries.

failures.title: LLM output normalization faults
failures.detail: Dropped numeric indicators, missing trim, and weakened type guards silently alter clinical fields under mutation testing.

failures.title: Undecodable upload / missing checkpoint
failures.detail: API preprocess fails when image bytes cannot be decoded; serving requires a trained checkpoint produced by the training pipeline.

failures.title: Wide test-set quality variance
failures.detail: Committed Results.ipynb reports PSNR range 10.31–26.08 dB on the test set.

failures.title: hos_engine import failure on host packaging
failures.detail: Vercel backend root deploy required vendoring hos_engine so the domain package remains importable (commit 550c0475b0915ca302fbe38b57489d31c03650ea).

glossary.definition: Architecture Decision Record style entries in engineering case files (decision, context, and provenance).
Fetch relevant indexed source context before LLM generation (retrieval-first pipeline).
Inject small code faults (mutants) and measure whether tests kill them; used on DeepMed clinical modules with Stryker.
Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio — image restoration metric reported in Underwater evaluation notebooks.
Structural Similarity Index — paired with PSNR in Underwater evaluation.
Running a trained model to produce outputs (e.g. FastAPI /api/enhance serving AttentionResUNet).
Evidence that behavior matches the intended contract — tests, mutation scores, metrics notebooks — not claims alone.
Production-style model or API exposure path, including CPU-forced serving defaults when GPU deploy is unreliable.
Ordered stages such as ingestion→embedding→retrieval→prompt→generation, or voice intake→severity→scheduling.
A trust or API edge — e.g. hos_engine vs Django, severity tier thresholds, or AI behind defined APIs.
